neighbours.label: Education policy about attainment gaps and levels: 'at all levels', 'narrow existing achievement gaps'; the same verbs about other things stay quiet
fire: Good preschools can narrow existing achievement gaps in reading.
Teachers at all levels attended the training.
The centre serves pupils at all levels of schooling.
Better funding could close existing gaps between rich and poor pupils.
Courses are offered at all levels, from infants to university.
Early tutoring may narrow existing learning gaps.
The reforms reach schools at all levels across the country.
Testing can deepen existing gaps in school funding.
quiet: Good shoes can narrow your stride in long races.
Workers at the plant attended the training.
The centre serves food at lunch on weekdays.
Better roads could close the distance between two towns.
Courses are offered at the hall, from May to June.
Early frost may damage young apple trees.
The trains reach towns in the north across the country.
Testing can slow repairs in city buses.

notes: Card: ' all' x6, ',' x3, ' and' x3, ' increase' x3, ' existing', ' deepen', on education policy. The + pole's logit effect suppresses ' educational', ' curriculum', ' school', so the - pole points toward them. Probe: 'at all' 0.86, 'narrow existing' 0.58; but 'deepen the nation's social divide' 0.10 and 'crisis of separate and unequal' 0.07, so this is uneven.
